seite.einleitung: What else Ablago can do, explained briefly.
seite.keine-tipps: There are no tips for you right now.
seite.einblenden.titel: Show this tip on the start page again
seite.aus: The tip of the day is switched off. You can switch it on under My account → Appearance.
seite.fehler: “Discover Ablago” cannot be loaded right now.
zeile.neu-weitere: New since your last visit: {text} – and {anzahl} more
konto.tipps.hilfe: At most one a day: a dot on the assistant at the bottom right shows it. All tips are in the assistant under “Tips”.
fuehrung.ueberspringen.titel: End the tour – it will not appear again by itself
fuehrung.spaeter.titel: Close now and offer it again the next time you sign in
fuehrung.ersatz: There is nothing to show here yet.
fuehrung.ohne-mappe.text: As soon as there is a folder you may open, Ablago shows you the spot there.
bild.titel: Sketch of Ablago: views on the left, the list in the middle, the open folder on the right.
bild.titel-handy: Sketch of Ablago on a phone: the view at the top, the list below it.
rundgang.ablago.beschreibung: The most important places in your library – in order, from the top left to the bottom right.
rundgang.ablago.ende: That’s it! You will find this and other tours in the assistant under “Tips”.
rundgang.ablago.neu.text: Use “+ New” to file post, for example a scanned letter. It waits in “New post” until you assign it to a folder.
rundgang.ablago.neu.ort: The “+ New” button is at the top, in the header.
rundgang.ablago.suche.text: Type a name, a number or a word at the top and press Enter: the advanced search shows all hits. The / key takes you here from any page.
rundgang.ablago.suche.ort: The search box is at the top, in the header.
rundgang.ablago.konto.text: Under your name is “My account”: font size and appearance, notifications, security. At the top, “Back to the library” brings you back here.
rundgang.ablago.konto.text-verwalten: Under your name: “My account” with font size, notifications and security, and back via “Back to the library”. With “Administer Ablago” you set Ablago up for everyone.
rundgang.ablago.konto.ort: The button with your name is at the top right and opens the user menu.
rundgang.ablago.assistent.text: The assistant waits at the bottom right – on every page. There you find more tips, can ask questions and open the manual.
rundgang.ablago.assistent.ort: The round button of the assistant is at the bottom right.
rundgang.ablago.logo.text: A click on the logo takes you back to the start page from any page.
rundgang.ablago.logo.ort: The logo is at the top left.
rundgang.ablago.ansichten.text: On the left you choose what you want to see. “To do” lists what is coming up: tasks, reminders and deadlines. Ablago reminds you in good time.
rundgang.ablago.ansichten.text-handy: Here you choose what you want to see – for example “To do” with tasks, reminders and deadlines. Ablago reminds you in good time.
rundgang.ablago.ansichten.ort: The views are on the left; on narrow screens you choose them at the top under “View”.
rundgang.ablago.liste.text: The middle shows what belongs to the chosen view. Click a folder and it opens to the right. A folder holds everything about one thing.
rundgang.ablago.liste.text-handy: Here you see what belongs to the chosen view. Tap a folder to open it. A folder holds everything about one thing.
rundgang.ablago.liste.ort: The list is in the middle.
rundgang.werkbank.beschreibung: This is where you set up Ablago for everyone. The most important places in order, from the top left to the bottom right.
rundgang.werkbank.ende: That’s it! You will find this tour again in the assistant under “Tips”. Enjoy setting things up.
rundgang.werkbank.logo.text: A click on the logo takes you back to the start from any page – here to the Workbench overview.
rundgang.werkbank.logo.ort: The logo is at the top left.
rundgang.werkbank.bereiche.text: The Library holds your documents and folders. In the Workbench you set Ablago up. Here you switch between the two.
rundgang.werkbank.bereiche.ort: “Library” and “Workbench” are at the top left next to the logo.
rundgang.werkbank.menue.text: Under your name you get to My account, end administration or sign out – on every page.
rundgang.werkbank.menue.ort: The button with your name is at the top right.
rundgang.werkbank.navigation.text: On the left the Workbench is split into large areas, for example “Build the Library” with packages and folder types, or “Users and security”.
rundgang.werkbank.navigation.ort: The areas are listed on the left.
rundgang.werkbank.benutzer.text: Under “Users” you add more people or invite them by e-mail – each with their own login and their own rights.
rundgang.werkbank.benutzer.ort: “Users” is on the left in the group “Users and security”.
rundgang.werkbank.uebersicht.text: The overview shows what needs attention right now. You deal with each note using its button, or acknowledge it on purpose.
rundgang.werkbank.uebersicht.ort: The overview is the first page of the Workbench.
rundgang.werkbank.anpassen.text: Ablago grows with you. To keep things simple, the Workbench first shows the basic setup. If you want more, show further areas here.
rundgang.werkbank.anpassen.ort: “Customise Workbench” is at the bottom of the list on the left.
rundgang.werkbank.assistent.text: The assistant waits at the bottom right. It helps with tips, answers questions and opens the manual for administrators.
rundgang.werkbank.assistent.ort: The round button of the assistant is at the bottom right.
rundgang.mappe.beschreibung: A folder holds everything about one thing. This is how you find your way around it – from top to bottom.
rundgang.mappe.ersatz: Open a folder – then this tour shows you how to work in it.
rundgang.mappe.ende: That’s it! You will find this tour again in the assistant under “Tips”.
rundgang.mappe.kopf.titel: At the top: what it is
rundgang.mappe.kopf.text: At the top you see what kind of folder this is, what it is called and who created and last changed it, and when.
rundgang.mappe.kopf.ort: Kind and title are at the top of the folder.
rundgang.mappe.stern.text: Use the star to remember the folder. You will then find it on the left under “Favourites”.
rundgang.mappe.stern.ort: The star is at the top right next to the title.
rundgang.mappe.menue.titel: What you can do with the folder
rundgang.mappe.menue.text: “Folder” lists the actions, for example filling in from a document, assigning a task, setting a reminder or sending it by e-mail.
rundgang.mappe.menue.ort: The “Folder” button is at the top right.
rundgang.mappe.register.text: “General” holds the fields, next to it are documents, links and notes. The number shows how many there are of each.
rundgang.mappe.register.ort: The tabs are below the title.
rundgang.mappe.speichern.text: Changes only count once you press “Save folder” at the bottom. “Discard changes” undoes them.
rundgang.mappe.speichern.ort: The bar with “Save folder” is at the bottom of the folder.
rundgang.konto.beschreibung: What you can set up for yourself here – in order, from top to bottom.
rundgang.konto.ende: That’s it! “Back to the library” takes you onwards.
rundgang.konto.zurueck.text: From every page in My account this takes you back to where you were in the library.
rundgang.konto.zurueck.ort: “Back to the library” is at the top left.
rundgang.konto.konto.text: Your name, the language and the e-mail address you sign in with.
rundgang.konto.konto.ort: “Account” is in the list of sections.
rundgang.konto.sicherheit.text: Here you change your password, set up a passkey or two-step sign-in, and see where you are signed in.
rundgang.konto.sicherheit.ort: “Security” is in the list of sections.
rundgang.konto.darstellung.text: Colours, font size, your start page and the tips – whatever suits you best.
rundgang.konto.darstellung.ort: “Appearance” is in the list of sections.
rundgang.konto.benachrichtigungen.text: Here you choose when the daily summary arrives by e-mail and whether you hear about changes to your favourites.
rundgang.konto.benachrichtigungen.ort: “Notifications” is in the list of sections.
rundgang.konto.abwesenheit.text: Going away? Enter who stands in for you here. Your tasks then go to that person.
rundgang.konto.abwesenheit.ort: “Absence” is in the list of sections.
rundgang.konto.fehler.text: If something seems wrong, report it here. Under “My reports” you see whether it has been dealt with.
rundgang.konto.fehler.ort: “Report an error” is the last entry in the list of sections.
tipp.suche-in-dokumenten: In a view, “Search in” on the search box at the top lets the search include the text of your letters and invoices.
tipp.favoriten: Use the star in a folder to keep it handy. You will then find it on the left under “Favourites”.
tipp.zu-erledigen-monat: In “To do”, “Month” shows all deadlines and reminders like a calendar.
tipp.neue-post-zuordnen: Click a letter in “New post”: the document in the middle, on the right you choose where it belongs – new folder (prefilled), existing one or just done.
tipp.schriftgroesse: Is the text too small? Under “My account” → “Appearance” you can make it bigger.
tipp.archivnummer: Is there an archive number on a paper? Type it into the search box at the top and press Enter to open exactly that document.
tipp.post-ablegen: Use “+ New” to file post. On a phone you can photograph a letter straight away with the camera.
tipp.frag-deine-ablage: In the assistant at the bottom right, “Ask” takes a question in full sentences, for example: When does the phone contract end?
tipp.fragen-oder-suchen: Ask questions in the assistant at the bottom right and search in the box at the top – Enter there shows all hits.
tipp.erinnern: In any folder, choose “Folder ▾” → “Remind” to set a date. Ablago then lets you know in “To do”.
tipp.abwesenheit: Away for a while? Enter your stand-in under “Absence” – new tasks then go to that person.
tipp.erweiterte-suche: With the advanced search you can find, for example, all invoices that have not been paid yet.
tipp.zusammenfassung: With the Daily summary you get an email each morning with everything that is coming up for you.
tipp.startseite-kachel: Under “My account” → “Appearance” you choose which view appears as the fourth tile on your start page.
tipp.laufwerk: You can connect your Library to your computer as a drive. Under your name → “My account” → “Drive” explains how.
tipp.rundgang: Would you like to see the short tour of Ablago again? It only takes a minute.
tipp.pakete: Ready-made folder types, for example for contracts or insurance, come as packages. You find them via “Administer Ablago” under “Packages”.
tipp.benutzer-einladen: Under “Administer Ablago” → “Users” you invite more people. Each of them gets their own account.
tipp.sicherung: Now and then, check under “Administer Ablago” → “Backup” when Ablago last backed everything up.
tipp.meintest-auch-bei-treffern: The search can suggest “Did you mean …?” even when it has already found something. You set this under “Search and full text”.
ziel-zeigen.leiste: Show target: click a highlighted place – its anchor goes into the file. Esc cancels.
hinweis.rundgang: New here? A short tour shows you what you can set up here.
